records.title: Signup and signed-out sessions
records.approved_text: **Selected: signup B + revocation A.** Keep Python as the identity/JWT/refresh/reset/workspace/RLS authority. For **new** signups, verify email before creating the permanent user/company/workspace (Node-style pending registration), with safe, idempotent verification. For protected operations, fail closed if token revocation cannot be verified; do not silently reinstate logged-out tokens when Redis/revocation infrastructure is down. Preserve existing users, memberships, accounts and safe session compatibility. Test duplicate registration, retries, invitations, existing tenants, trials, session refresh and outage behavior.
records.pending_details: No additional signup/revocation policy choice is specified as pending in the owner register. Preserve existing-user/session compatibility; rollout details and implementation permission remain separate gates.

records.title: Platform authority
records.approved_text: **Selected: A (strict platform ownership).** Keep tenant owner/admin separate from KEEL platform owner/admin. Platform admins may manage companies, ordinary catalog/promotions/quotes within assigned permissions. **Only the Platform Owner** may authorize below-floor pricing, exceptional unpaid/manual financial access, or provider spending-control changes. Separate platform invitations from customer team invitations; enforce permission checks server-side with immutable audit trails. Tenant ownership never grants platform staff privilege.
records.pending_details: No additional platform-authority policy choice is specified as pending. Actual assigned permissions and exceptional owner authorizations must be explicit and audited; no impersonation or other unstated powers are granted.

records.title: Commercial catalog
records.approved_text: **Selected: A (preserve current Python commercial terms).** Keep existing Python public plan prices, limits, trial eligibility/durations, price mappings, historical contracts, private terms and grandfathered access unchanged. Port missing Node-style catalog management, versioning, configurability and history to Python without automatically changing customers' purchased terms. Any future new commercial catalog requires a separately approved version, customer cohort, values, date and impact review.
records.pending_details: Any future commercial catalog change remains PENDING a separately approved version, cohort, exact values, effective date and impact review. Existing Python commercial terms remain unchanged.

records.title: Entitlements, competitor caps and sources
records.selection_label: competitor A + source A + rights A
records.approved_text: **Selected: competitor A + source A + rights A.** Continue current Python **Data/AI Credit-based competitor policy**, with no new fixed competitor cap on existing public plans; configurable count caps are allowed for **future separately approved custom contracts**. Count **each active persistent** Shopify, WooCommerce, approved database/API or other persistent connection **once** against the connected-source allowance; one-time manual uploads are not persistent connections. Preserve/grandfather all customers' effective feature rights before applying new explicit gates, and require impact assessment plus separate rollout approval for source-count changes that would affect customers. Keep Python Credits distinct from feature counts/capacities.
records.pending_details: PENDING: effective-rights impact assessment, grandfathering and separate rollout approval where active persistent-source counting changes customer access. Future custom-contract count caps require a separately approved contract and values; no new fixed public competitor cap.

records.title: Promotion eligibility and redemption
records.selection_label: reuse A + consumption A + stacking A
records.approved_text: **Selected: reuse A + consumption A + stacking A.** Promotional redemption allowances are **per tenant/company**, not per person. Count a redemption only after **settlement of the initial subscription invoice**, including valid fully discounted zero-total invoices; failed/abandoned checkouts do not permanently consume a use. **No stacking** a promo with an already discounted custom offer. Stripe remains monetary discount authority; port Node's managed promo eligibility, constraints, atomic redemption, idempotency and reconciliation into Python. Preserve historical Stripe discounts. **Pending for each promo:** amount/type, eligible plans/currencies, dates, global/per-tenant limits, initial vs renewal scope and exact Stripe mapping.
records.pending_details: PENDING for each promotion: amount/type, eligible plans/currencies, dates, global/per-tenant limits, initial versus renewal scope and exact Stripe mapping. Architecture selection does not enable any unspecified promo.

records.title: Quote acceptance and activation
records.selection_label: manual-contract A; Stripe normally precedes manual
records.approved_text: **Selected: manual-contract A; Stripe normally precedes manual.** Preserve Node's customer custom configurator, quote/revision, approval and acceptance workflows. Acceptance alone never activates paid access: normal activation requires confirmed Stripe billing under Python's authoritative subscription assignment. **Platform Owner** may separately authorize a documented, audited and time-bounded manual/offline contract exception. Live Stripe subscription normally takes precedence; explicit manual exceptions cannot silently erase paid rights. Preserve preexisting manual/private contracts and Python credits. **Pending details:** exact precedence/expiry/reconciliation semantics for exceptional overlapping grants.
records.pending_details: PENDING: precise precedence, expiry and reconciliation semantics for exceptional overlapping manual/Stripe grants. No manual exception is activated by this ADR; Platform Owner authorization must be documented, audited and time-bounded.

records.title: Quote economics
records.selection_label: cost-based A + USD-only initial checkout + frozen approved FX during quote validity
records.approved_text: **Selected: cost-based A + USD-only initial checkout + frozen approved FX during quote validity.** Port full Node quote engine behavior (Decimal calculation, vendor/infrastructure/other costs, margin floor, fees, upward rounding, warnings, approval thresholds and snapshots) to Python; obtain applicable provider-rate truth from Python's verified provider schedules without changing actual Credits/provider-cost accounting. Initial Stripe checkout **USD only**. Keep an approved quote's FX/rate version frozen during its valid acceptance/payment window; after expiry require a new approved quote. Unknown/unverified costs or FX block automated checkout and route to review. **PENDING, not inferred:** exact margin(s), cost floors/ratios, fees, multipliers, rounding increments, verified rates, FX source, quote expiration, renewal rules and instant-approval thresholds. Automatic custom checkout remains blocked until necessary parameters are approved.
records.pending_details: PENDING: exact margins, cost floors/ratios, fees, multipliers, rounding increments, verified provider rates, FX source, quote expiry, renewal rules and instant-approval thresholds. Automated custom checkout stays blocked until required parameters are approved.

records.title: Mixed plan changes
records.approved_text: **Selected: mixed A + overcapacity A.** Determine change type by comparing actual effective Boolean, SUM, MAX, private-plan and monitoring grants, not just tier/price. If a change both improves and reduces rights, **schedule the entire change for next billing period**, preserving current paid rights in the interim and requiring appropriate confirmed billing before applying changed entitlements. Pure upgrades with no reductions may take effect sooner after confirmed billing according to established Python provider rules. If a downgrade makes a tenant over capacity, retain existing products, competitors and connections; block additional growth rather than deleting business records. Keep Python Stripe scheduling and defend against stale/delayed events and retries.
records.pending_details: No additional mixed-change/overcapacity policy choice is specified as pending. Preserve established Python confirmed-billing rules; release still requires native concurrency, provider-state and compatibility evidence and separately scoped implementation authorization.

records.title: Canonical import, inventories and overlap
records.selection_label: promotion A + inventory A + overlap A
records.approved_text: **Selected: promotion A + inventory A + overlap A.** Keep Python canonical transactions plus invoice/item mirrors and existing product identity. Auto-promote **strictly validated and unambiguous rows**; preview, hold and require review for conflicts, invalid values and ambiguous identity. Maintain **source-owned inventory lineage** for Shopify, WooCommerce and manual imports; never silently overwrite conflicting stocks. Detect manual/store overlapping sales using available external references, source/invoice metadata and product mappings, but do not coalesce distinct legitimate identical sales. Preserve IDs/history, taxes/shipping/refunds, idempotent retries, accurate partial statuses, tenant RLS and no duplicate revenue/stock decrements. **PENDING:** any universal source priority and shared-key collision rules not already supported by verified identity.
records.pending_details: PENDING: any universal source priority and external shared-key collision rules not already supported by verified identity. Do not guess precedence or merge legitimate identical sales.

records.title: Recommendation evidence and fallback
records.approved_text: **Selected: A (qualified fallback).** Preserve Python's pricing inference, demand/stock context and qualified peer/wider-market/internal fallback when direct local competitor evidence is inadequate; label the factual basis, confidence and limitations, and never imply fallback is verified local market pricing. Incorporate missing Node eligibility, currency/evidence validity, guardrails, entitlement and usage protection for single and bulk routes. Preserve history and evidence provenance. **PENDING:** maximal admissible observation age, FX/reference freshness where applicable and handling of a newest invalid observation. Do not sign off on final input policy until set.
records.pending_details: PENDING: maximal admissible observation age, FX/reference freshness where applicable and newest-invalid-observation handling. Final input policy is not signed off until these values/rules are approved.

records.title: Review samples and visible scoring
records.approved_text: **Selected: B (suppress unreliable numeric scores).** Preserve Python sentiment classification, weighted scoring and historical evidence for **BUSINESS, PRODUCT and COMPETITOR**. Validate tenant ownership/subject identity; port Node eligibility/deduplication/input validation and usage protections. When eligible reviews are below approved minimum, show **UNKNOWN/null**, not numeric zero or a misleading score; do not re-charge for repeated summary reads. **PENDING:** exact eligible-review minimum, sampling cap, recency and source rules. Do not invent these thresholds.
records.pending_details: PENDING: minimum eligible-review count, sampling cap, recency and source rules. Numeric-score visibility and applicable release acceptance depend on these approvals; no threshold is inferred.

records.title: Failed, partial and ambiguous work
records.approved_text: **Selected: feature A + uncertain-delivery B.** Consume feature allowances for **usable retained outputs** under the applicable defined metering unit; refund/release proven unused reservations and account for confirmed partial commits. If provider work may have completed but client delivery cannot be proved, provide a **controlled, auditable, idempotent customer allowance adjustment** while **retaining actual provider cost** in Python's immutable ledger. Maintain separate customer feature allowances, customer Data/AI Credits and actual provider USD spend; enforce durable request/period receipts, once-only settlement, crash recovery, no duplicate retry charges and period-safe adjustments. **PENDING:** exact per-feature metering units and allowable adjustment limits where not already contractually established.
records.pending_details: PENDING: exact per-feature metering units and allowable ambiguous-delivery adjustment limits where not already contractually established. Customer allowance adjustments never erase actual provider cost or rewrite the immutable Credits ledger.

records.title: Shopify privacy and retained records
records.approved_text: **Selected: A (targeted privacy erasure/restriction).** Implement verified signed Shopify privacy/uninstall/data requests, including shop/topic/delivery checks, dedupe, recoverable audited jobs, tenant attribution and fences preventing reimport of data erased under a valid request. Erase or restrict **Shopify-attributable personal information** that is covered by the request; retain financial/audit records only where applicable law and an approved policy permit or require. Preserve Python's existing company export/delete protections and unrelated manual/customer data. **PENDING for legal/operational sign-off:** jurisdictions, specific affected fields, retention schedules, legal bases/exceptions and permission/approval for irreversible actions. Do not invent retention periods or execute irreversible deletion without authorization.
records.pending_details: PENDING legal/operational sign-off: jurisdictions, specific affected fields, retention schedules, legal bases/exceptions and permission/approval for irreversible actions. This policy selection does not authorize deletion or invent any retention duration.
